alate: The head is brown, the postclypeus, antennae, thoracic and abdominal tergites and wings pale brown, the compound eyes black, the anteclypeus white, the fontanelle yellowish white; the head, mesonotum, wing scales and abdominal tergites bear numerous long and short hairs. The head is broadly oval, widest at the middle and narrowing towards both ends. The fontanelle is rather large, shaped like a long oval narrowed at the front end and rounded at the back, with a faintly discernible V-shaped bifurcating line on each anterolateral side, its surface slightly depressed and not raised. The postclypeus is raised and lacks a median longitudinal line. Antennae with 15 segments, the scape the thickest and longest, segment 3 the shortest and smallest. The ocelli are elliptical and not distinctly projecting, their distance from the compound eye less than the short diameter of the ocellus itself; the compound eyes are large and strongly projecting, their distance to the lower margin of the head less than the ocellus-compound eye distance. The left mandible has four teeth, the apical tooth the longest and pointed, marginal tooth 3 reduced to a mere dot. The anterior margin of the pronotum is almost straight, the posterior margin slightly concave, the T-shaped mark indistinct. The forewing scale is larger than the hindwing scale. The media of the forewing arises independently at the shoulder suture and rather nearer the cubitus, with five to six branches behind; the media of the hindwing arises from the base of the radial sector, with four branches behind.
soldier: Head rectangular, the sides slightly parallel, the frons not projecting or slightly raised. The mandibles are asymmetrical, the left mandible twisted, its apex narrow and curved inwards into a hook; the right mandible straighter and somewhat sabre-like, its apex slightly turned inwards, in a few specimens curved forwards or outwards, differing considerably from the left mandible. The labrum is usually longer than wide, the anterior notch shallow and flat. Antennae with 14 segments. The pronotum is narrower than the head and saddle-shaped. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.
